title: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2016

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2016
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2016
PUNJAB
URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2016
An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property
Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 23rd November, 2016]
No. Legis:
13-04/2002, dated 23.11.2016.---The following Ordinance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary to amend the Punjab
Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958) for purposes hereinafter
appearing.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is
not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be cited at the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax
(Amendment) Ordinance 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
